text:
An audit of the Brisco County public library system has found that 212 items of equipment, valued at $48,600, cannot be accounted for.

Dana Whitlock, the county's chief auditor, presented the findings to the Brisco County board on March 14, 2024, when the summary was released. The missing items include laptops, projectors and e-reader tablets, according to the "Brisco County Public Library System Asset Review, FY2023," a 37-page report on which the summary is based.

The review compared the library system's asset records against equipment that could be located. The 212 items were listed in those records but were not found.

Ms. Whitlock told board members that the report documents the shortfall in the library system's asset tracking. The board received the summary at the same meeting at which it was presented.

The full review is available through the county auditor's office.
